releases.title: CLI v2.7.4
releases.description:
- docs: clarify opt-in event emission in the CLI README (by @Likio3000, https://github.com/watchexec/watchexec/pull/1123)
- fix: error instead of panicking on an unreadable `@argfile` (by @00200200, https://github.com/watchexec/watchexec/pull/1129)
- fix: infer file type of removed paths from the event kind (by @lsh4711, https://github.com/watchexec/watchexec/pull/1130)
- fix: eliminate a potential race in the keyboard watcher (https://github.com/watchexec/watchexec/pull/1133)
- fix: exclude more shell constructs from the exec optimisation (https://github.com/watchexec/watchexec/pull/1135)
- deps: gix-config 0.61, process-wrap 9.1.1, clearscreen 5.0.0 (https://github.com/watchexec/watchexec/pull/1136)
